counting_policy.ability: One named entry in one version and one tree. Parameter investments and unit variants are identified separately. Shared names across editions are not collapsed.
counting_policy.ranks: Ranks and every numerical patch value are not separate abilities.
counting_policy.unknown: A null expected_count or unresolved_count means the denominator is not verified. It does not mean zero missing.
counting_policy.source_limits: No commercial assets, full guide descriptions, original game code, or extracted game packages are redistributed.

games.title: Divine Divinity

progression_rules.tree_structure: 88 ordinary visible tree entries (Warrior 32, Wizard 32, Survivor 24) plus 8 post-ascension Divine entries = 96; plus 3 innate class specials counted independently = 99 named player abilities.
progression_rules.interpretation: Starting class and sex affect starting characteristics and special abilities; they do not prohibit learning the other Ways.

dos2_classic.archives: All readable *.pak in that data directory, preserving patch layers and split archives; corresponding English localization archives.
dos2_classic.why: SkillData includes unused/NPC templates; item grants, summoned-child actions and recipe availability need resolved inheritance, localized names and template/quest linkage.

dos2_definitive.archives: All readable *.pak plus DefEd/Data/Localization/English.pak; retain the exact optional Larian mod/gift-bag enablement list.
dos2_definitive.why: The same visible names can have different stats and grant rules; optional gift bags must be enumerated independently.

dos_classic_and_enhanced.required: Original edition .pak layers plus English localization; export Stats/Generated/Data skill, weapon, armor/object and status tables, skill sets, root templates and ItemCombos data with the compatible LSLib/Divinity editor.
dos_classic_and_enhanced.why: The pinned planners cover character-creation nodes but omit quest and item grants; Tenebrium and Zombie Nick demonstrate that omission.
dos_classic_and_enhanced.safe_route: Use Norbyte/lslib appropriate game mode. No commercial game packages are redistributed by this repository.

files: dat/wgiaa.000 (relative to the original runtime data directory)
the English localization/string tables corresponding to the installed build
the original 96-entry player skill data and save/runtime spell-level mapping
divine_divinity.why: The 2002 manual and released UI establish 99 named player abilities. Exact values, prerequisites and broken-skill behavior need a specific installed build. OpenDivine RTTI docs are evidence of layouts, not a verified balance dump.
divine_divinity.file_name_note: OpenDivine documents dat/wgiaa.000 as shipped and dat/skillcosts.txt as an unshipped development import. Its interpretation as skill-point costs is not runtime-verified here and must not be adopted as original game balance.

divinity_ii.required_archives: The matching edition and language .dv2 archive corpus, preserving executable search order and shipped Patch.dv2 overrides; Developer’s Cut episode and world subdirectories must be retained.
divinity_ii.interpretation: Paths are archive-entry paths; the tool normalizes case and backslashes. These exact paths are documented for Developer’s Cut, not asserted unchanged in the original 2009 executable.
divinity_ii.why: The 63 named modern player skills are a UI/manual scope; 78 internal Skill definitions are a different scope. Their complete ID/name/access crosswalk is not available without the installed files. Do not infer 15 missing player skills from this subtraction.
divinity_ii.original_2009_gate: Use the original 2009 installation separately; its 61 named-player inventory is independently researched, while exact 2009 internal paths, definitions and rank values remain unverified.

beyond_divinity.why: The official guide enumerates skill investment leaves, but exact runtime grants, ranks and localized labels require the matching installed build. The translation-tool author locates some starting skill/quest text inside initial-save data.000; the script/VM evidence identifies initial Story files. These are not a verified complete skill-stat format map.
beyond_divinity.tool_limits: The localization tool works with loose files, not .dv archives, and does not support initial-save data.000.
